project_summary: Mobile banking API with OAuth 2.0 authentication, JWT sessions, and PSD2 compliance

components.name: OAuth 2.0 authentication backend
components.description: Implementation of OAuth 2.0 authorization code and refresh token flows with JWT-based session management, multi-tenant token isolation, and rate limiting per client.

components.name: Regulatory audit logging
components.description: Immutable audit trail for authentication, consent changes, account access, and sensitive banking operations.

project_summary: Marketplace checkout modernization with inventory synchronization and merchant dashboards

components.description: Backend service coordinating cart validation, payment authorization, discount rules, and order creation for marketplace purchases.

components.name: Inventory synchronization worker
components.description: Scheduled worker that synchronizes merchant stock levels, detects conflicts, and emits inventory update events.

project_summary: Patient intake platform with document upload, triage rules, and clinician review workflow

components.name: Patient intake form backend
components.description: Spring Boot API for structured patient intake forms, validation rules, consent capture, and secure submission tracking.

components.name: Clinical document upload
components.description: Secure upload flow for referral documents and lab results with file type validation and metadata extraction.

project_summary: Industrial maintenance dashboard with equipment telemetry ingestion and alerting

components.name: Telemetry ingestion service
components.description: API and queue consumer for ingesting machine telemetry, validating payloads, and storing normalized equipment events.

components.name: Maintenance alert rules
